description: This file implements the VssDatabase class, which manages a hierarchical JSON-based data structure representing vehicle sensor and actuator data in a Vehicle Signal Specification (VSS) standard. It includes methods for initializing the database from a JSON file, querying and updating data paths, applying default values, and handling signals and metadata, with thread safety and external dependencies for JSON processing and logging.

classes.name: VssDatabase
classes.description: A class managing a hierarchical JSON structure representing vehicle sensor and actuator data, providing methods for initialization, querying, updating, and metadata management within a thread-safe environment.

methods.name: isActor
methods.description: Checks if a JSON element represents an actuator type in VSS.

methods.name: isSensor
methods.description: Checks if a JSON element represents a sensor type in VSS.

methods.name: isAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a JSON element represents an attribute type in VSS.

methods.name: applyDefaultValues
methods.description: Recursively applies default values to attribute nodes in the VSS JSON tree.

methods.name: initJsonTree
methods.description: Initializes the VSS data and meta trees from a JSON file.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists in the data tree.

methods.name: pathIsWritable
methods.description: Determines if a path is writable (sensor or actuator).

methods.name: pathIsAttributable
methods.description: Checks if a specific attribute can be set on a path.

methods.name: pathIsReadable
methods.description: Checks if a path is readable (sensor, actuator, or attribute).

methods.name: checkPathValid
methods.description: Verifies if a path contains usable leaf nodes.

methods.name: getDatatypeForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the data type of a path, throws if not found or invalid.

methods.name: getLeafPaths
methods.description: Returns all leaf node paths under a given path.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specified path.

methods.name: setSignal
methods.description: Sets a signal value at a specified path and publishes the update.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Retrieves a signal value in JSON format from a specified path.

methods.name: updateJsonTree
methods.description: Applies a JSON patch to update the data tree.

methods.name: updateJsonTree
methods.description: Overloaded: updates the meta and data trees with a new JSON structure, with authorization check.

methods.name: updateMetaData
methods.description: Shallow merges metadata into a specific path in the trees, with authorization check.
